rationale: Grammatical inverses: Windows 2000 descendant of NT == NT has descendant Windows 2000.
A says first commander; B says only commander of, dropping the 'first' qualifier (broader claim).
B adds 'almost exclusively'; A is an unqualified, stronger claim.
'From time to time' and 'occasionally' are synonymous frequency qualifiers; same triple.
Holding a seat in the Arizona House of Representatives and being a member of it are the same, with identical dates and district.
B adds the 'first major engagement' description, which A omits; not the same complete assertion.
B adds purpose=internal character encoding; A is the broader claim that NT uses UTF-16.
Country of citizenship and nationality are synonymous here, with the same object and no qualifiers.
Identical triples.
Grammatical inverses: Windows XP descendant of NT == NT has descendant Windows XP.
Identical triples, including the condition qualifier.
A marks 2013 as the end point; B gives two undifferentiated 'point in time' values. Unsure the interval structure is equivalent, so not asserted.
B marks the distance as approximate; A states 110 light-years exactly.
Same first-commander relation and same June 20 to July 20, 1861 period, encoded as start/end versus a range. The 'General' title is not material.
Inverse relations (First Corps joined by Army of the Shenandoah == Army joined First Corps), same date.
B adds a 1992 time qualifier that A lacks.
A qualifies the discovery as 'possible'; B asserts the 2005 discovery without that status.
A has a purpose qualifier (aims of the Agreement on Social Policy) that B lacks.
HD 11964 c orbiting HD 11964 and HD 11964 being its host star are the same assertion.
A adds a June-July 1861 time qualifier that the text does not give for the flag's creation and B lacks.
A is inverse in form but carries an 'under General J.E. Johnston' qualifier that B lacks.
Both have negative polarity, but 'part of the Treaty' differs from 'is not a chapter of the Treaty'; the text only denies being a chapter. Not the same assertion.
Both say the Social Charter was adopted by 11 of the 12 member states; the count is in the object in A and in a qualifier in B.
The unit qualifier in B only restates the Earth masses already in A's object.
